slides.label: Your dasha
slides.title:
The chapter
you’re in
slides.subtitle:
Why some years carry one theme
however the sky moves

slides.label: What it means
slides.title: Dasha
body: Jyotish splits your life into periods called dashas
Each one is run by a single graha
Parashara’s main system, Vimshottari, runs 120 years

slides.label: Three chapters
slides.title: Who runs your years
items: Building slowly; patience pays more than talent
Wanting more: new cities, new industries
Teachers, study, children, a wider circle

slides.label: Chapter and weather
slides.title: A rainy week
body: A transit is a few weeks or months of weather
A rainy week in a good chapter is still a good chapter
A sunny week in a hard chapter doesn’t change the plot

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
Read the chapter
before you blame the weather

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Write one line
body: Find your dasha and the house its graha sits in
Check every big decision against that line
